epithet: Ghorr steward of the near fields
bio: A Ghorr steward whose precise, bred grain rots while the loose margins hold; wants the anomaly studied, not buried.
context_line: Ilse wants the sealed sack opened and studied; the rot in her fields skips the weedy margins and takes the bred rows.
dialogue_warm: Walk my furrows and tell me the Waning only touches castings.
